name: Fitness Tracker
highLevelGoals: Enable users to accurately record and monitor their physical activities to understand their exercise habits and performance over time.
Provide users with clear and engaging visual representations of their fitness data to help them easily assess their consistency, improvements, and overall progress.
Allow users to define, adjust, and track their personal fitness objectives to maintain focus and work towards specific health and fitness targets.
Offer personalized workout plans and suggestions that adapt to the user's fitness level, preferences, and goals to optimize their training efficiency and outcomes.
Enable users to share their fitness activities and milestones on social media platforms to foster engagement, celebrate progress, and motivate their network.
Automatically collect and transmit accurate fitness data to the application, ensuring seamless and up-to-date tracking of user activities and biometrics.
Ensure continuous and immediate synchronization of fitness data with the application, providing users with current and accurate information about their progress.
lowLevelGoals: The Fitness User initiates the recording of a new physical activity session within the application.
The Fitness User concludes the recording of the current physical activity session.
The Fitness User requests to see a summary of a completed physical activity, including metrics like duration, distance, and calories burned.
The Fitness User navigates through a list of all previously recorded physical activities.
The Fitness User chooses a specific type of activity (e.g., running, cycling, swimming) before starting a new tracking session.
The Fitness User inputs details for an activity not automatically tracked (e.g., yoga, weightlifting).
The Fitness User views a graphical representation of their activity data over a selected period (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly).
The Fitness User applies filters to the visual progress display, such as by activity type, date range, or specific metric.
The Fitness User requests a detailed report or summary of their fitness progress, potentially including trends and comparisons.
The Fitness User compares their current performance metrics against past records or personal bests using visual tools.
The Fitness User defines a new fitness goal, specifying parameters such as target metric, value, and deadline.
The Fitness User updates the details of an already established fitness goal.
The Fitness User checks the current status and progress towards their active fitness goals.
The Fitness User manually marks a fitness goal as achieved.
The Fitness User removes an unwanted or outdated fitness goal.
The Fitness User asks the system to generate a new personalized workout plan based on their current fitness level and goals.
The Fitness User modifies their preferences (e.g., workout intensity, duration, equipment availability) to influence future workout recommendations.
The Fitness User accesses the details of a recommended workout, including exercises, sets, and reps.
The Fitness User confirms the completion of a recommended workout, allowing the system to update their progress and adapt future recommendations.
The Fitness User selects a completed activity and initiates sharing it to a chosen social media platform.
The Fitness User adds a personal message, image, or selects specific metrics to include in their social media post before sharing.
The Fitness User shares the successful completion of a fitness goal on social media.
The Wearable Device sends recorded activity data (e.g., steps, heart rate, GPS) to the fitness application.
The Wearable Device sends biometric data (e.g., sleep patterns, continuous heart rate) to the fitness application.
The Wearable Device establishes a connection and begins the process of synchronizing all available fitness data with the application.
The Wearable Device pushes new or updated fitness data to the application in real-time as it is collected.
The Wearable Device sends a confirmation to the application that data has been successfully and accurately synchronized.
